WITH NavXpAlertsCTE AS
(
    SELECT
        m.ModuleID AS resourceId,
        'Medium' AS severity,
        JSON_QUERY
        (
            (
                SELECT
                    t.TabID AS PageNumber,
                    t.TabName AS PageName,
                    tm.ModuleTitle,
                    tm.PaneName,
                    t.PortalID AS PortalId,
                    pl.PortalName,
                    m.ModuleID,
                    ni.InstanceName,
                    ni.Template,
                    ni.IncludeBootstrap,
                    LTRIM(
                        CONCAT(
                            CASE
                                WHEN ni.IncludeBootstrap = 1
                                    THEN 'The Settings / Include Bootstrap checkbox is checked'
                                ELSE ''
                            END,
                            CASE
                                WHEN ni.IncludeBootstrap = 1
                                     AND ni.Template IN
                                     (
                                         'BootstrapTopFixed',
                                         'BootstrapRightSticky',
                                         'BootstrapLeftSticky',
                                         'BootstrapTopSticky',
                                         'PageBuilderDefault'
                                     )
                                    THEN '; '
                                ELSE ''
                            END,
                            CASE
                                WHEN ni.Template IN
                                     (
                                         'BootstrapTopFixed',
                                         'BootstrapRightSticky',
                                         'BootstrapLeftSticky',
                                         'BootstrapTopSticky',
                                         'PageBuilderDefault'
                                     )
                                    THEN CONCAT(
                                        'The Settings / Template value, ',
                                        ni.Template,
                                        ', is Bootstrap3'
                                    )
                                ELSE ''
                            END
                        )
                    ) AS Details,
                    'true' AS paa_preventMajorUpgrades
                FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER
            )
        ) AS properties,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY m.ModuleID
            ORDER BY t.TabID
        ) AS rn
    FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}DnnSharp_NavXp_Instances] ni
    INNER JOIN {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}Modules] m
        ON m.ModuleID = ni.ModuleID
    INNER JOIN {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}TabModules] tm
        ON tm.ModuleID = m.ModuleID
    INNER JOIN {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}Tabs] t
        ON t.TabID = tm.TabID
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pl.PortalName
        FROM {databaseOwner}[{objectQualifier}PortalLocalization] pl
        WHERE pl.PortalID = t.PortalID
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN pl.CultureCode = 'en-US' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            pl.CultureCode
    ) pl
    WHERE
        tm.IsDeleted = 0
        AND
        (
            ni.IncludeBootstrap = 1
            OR ni.Template IN
            (
                'BootstrapTopFixed',
                'BootstrapRightSticky',
                'BootstrapLeftSticky',
                'BootstrapTopSticky',
                'PageBuilderDefault'
            )
        )
)
SELECT
(
    SELECT
        resourceId,
        severity,
        properties
    FROM NavXpAlertsCTE
    WHERE rn = 1
    FOR JSON PATH
) AS PAASysAlerts;
